text: EPM 6010 Building Automation Power Meter | GE Vernova | Electrification

The Multilin EPM 6010 is an industry leading revenue grade power meter with native BACnet/IP communications. This meter is designed to integrate seamlessly into existing and new building management systems using the popular BACnet protocol. The meter allows users to gather data on voltage, current, power and energy usage throughout a facility.

text: The Multilin EPM 6010 with BACnet/IP supports building energy management strategies, LEED certification and other Green Building initiatives. By allowing users to track energy use and power quality, the meters gives users the information they need to accurately identify cost -saving measures and respond to power quality problems when they arise.
heading: BACnet/IP COMMUNICATIONS

text: The Multilin EPM 6010 provides two independent communication ports with advanced features:
heading: Communications Ports

text: IrDA port – A unique optical IrDA port allows the unit to be setup and programmed using a remote laptop without needing a communication cable. Simply point at the meter with an IrDA-equipped PC computer to configure it.
heading: Communications Ports

text: Ethernet Port – This port provides connectivity via a 10/100BaseT RJ45 connection. Modbus TCP and BACnet protocols are supported
heading: Communications Ports

text: The Multilin EPM 6010 comes standard with a web interface. Use the BACnet/IP interface to remotely set up the BACnet/ IP configuration and track energy use with any standard web browser.
heading: BACnet/IP Web Interface

text: EnerVista Launchpad is a powerful software package that provides users a platform to access all of the setup and support tools needed for configuring and maintaining GE Vernova Multilin Products. Launchpad allows configuration of devices in real-time by communicating using RS232, RS485, Ethernet or modem connections. Using Launchpad as the single interface to the setup and analysis software makes it simple to enter setpoints, read metered values, monitor status and evaluate power quality.
heading: EnerVista Software

text: Viewpoint Monitoring is a simple-to-use, full-featured monitoring and data recording software package for small systems. Viewpoint Monitoring provides a complete HMI package that instantly puts critical real-time device data on your PC through pre-configured graphical screens with the following functionality.

text: This meter allows voltage input measurements up to 416 Volts Line to Neutral and 721 volts Line to Line. This helps ensure proper meter safety when wiring directly to high voltage systems. The unit will perform to specification on 69 Volt, 120 Volt, 230 Volt, 277 Volt and 347 Volt power systems.
heading: Universal Voltage and Current

text: EPM 6010 meter uses two current input wiring methods.
heading: Unique Current Input Connections

text: Method One - CT pass through. Directly pass the CT through the meter without any physical termination on the meter.
heading: Unique Current Input Connections

text: This insures that the meter cannot be a point of failure on the CT circuit. This is preferable to utility users when sharing relay class CTs.
heading: Unique Current Input Connections

text: No Burden is added to the secondary CT circuit.
heading: Unique Current Input Connections

text: Method Two - Current "Gills." The meter additionally provides ultra-rugged termination pass through bars allowing the CT leads to be terminated on the meter. This also eliminates any possible point of failure at the meter. This method is also a preferred technique for ensuring relay class CT integrity does not get compromised. No terminal blocks are required and this stud based design ensures that CTs will not open under a fault condition.
heading: Unique Current Input Connections

text: Through a standard Ethernet port, the EPM 6010 can easily integrate into systems using BACnet/IP or Modbus TCP.
heading: Unique Current Input Connections

text: The EPM 6010 has a rugged design for harsh environment. This is especially important in power generation, utility substation, and critical user applications. The structural and electrical design of this meter was developed based on the recommendations and approvals of many of our utility customers.
heading: Solid Construction with Mounting Versatility

text: EPM 6010 can easily be mounted in a panel for generator monitoring, substation automation and more. The unique dual design combines ANSI and DIN mounting structure and allows easy installation for both new metering applications and retrofit of existing analog meters.
heading: Solid Construction with Mounting Versatility

text: The unit mounts directly in an ANSI C39.1 (4" Round form) or an IEC 92 mm DIN square form.
heading: Solid Construction with Mounting Versatility
